Herdr UI map

The names to use for each part of the screen, in issues, specs and prompts. The picture is the real app rendered from its components with sample data (2026-10-11). Point at a number or a name to see the area. The same names are in CONTEXT.md › UI surfaces; mise run docs:ui-map redraws this page.

Light and dark share the same layout.

Sidebar

  1. 1
    Sidebar

    The left column: Bookmarks, Sessions, Machines.

    src/sidebar/Sidebar.tsx
  2. 2
    Layout controls

    Beside the traffic lights: ⌘B hides the Sidebar, ⇧⌘B the Agents column too.

    src/main/LayoutControls.tsx
  3. 3
    Board button

    Opens the Agent Board (⇧⌘D); the count is the agents that need you.

    .board-btn in LayoutControls
  4. 4
    Bookmarks

    Workspaces pinned to the top; a closed one waits under the same name.

    useLayout().bookmarks
  5. 5
    Sessions filter

    All | Active on the Sessions header.

    useSessionFilter (src/sidebar/activeFilter.ts)
  6. 6
    Session row

    A Session in the Sidebar.

    SessionRow
  7. 7
    Workspace row

    A Workspace with agent work, under its Session row.

    ProjectRows
  8. 8
    Fold line

    “N hidden · idle or stopped”: what the Active filter hides, with Show.

    .filter-hidden in GroupTree
  9. 9
    Machines

    The machines herdr runs on, local and over SSH.

    li.machine in Sidebar

  1. 10
    Agents column

    The middle column, headed by the Session name and PANES.

    src/agents/AgentList.tsx

Main area

  1. 19
    Top bar

    The main area's one bar, as tall as the columns' heads: the Open strip, then the Lens switch.

    src/main/TopBar.tsx

    Open strip

    src/chat/QueuedMessages.tsx
